GRAND AVENUE e FRANKLIN PARK, ILL. 601317 SERVICE BULLETIN GAME: Sea Wolf SUBJECT: Roms and Proms - Self Testing The Sea Wolf micro-computer system has been programmed to detect a defective prom. To utilize the test, proceed as follows: (1) Set switches #6, #7, and #8 to the 'Off' position (PC 596-904). (2) Activate coin door tilt switch. (3) Operate coin switch manually. (4) When a prom is defective internally, a letter will appear displayed on the TV screen locating the faulty prom (PC 80-900). (5) When all proms are good, the TV screen will display nothing but the waves. (6) Return switches #6, #7, and #8 to normal positions. (7) Activate tilt switch to return game to normal operation. The above test will not function when the program test it- self is defective or a prom fault is external. AD/r 3/8/76
